mapper.insert: insert into notify_task ( activity_id, team_id, notify_category, notify_type, notify_mq, notify_url, notify_count, notify_status, parameter_json, uuid, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{activityId}, #{teamId}, #{notifyCategory}, #{notifyType}, #{notifyMq}, #{notifyUrl}, #{notifyCount}, #{notifyStatus}, #{parameterJson}, #{uuid}, now(), now() ) on duplicate key update update_time = now()
mapper.select: select id, activity_id, team_id, notify_category, notify_type, notify_mq, notify_url, notify_count, notify_status, parameter_json, uuid, create_time, update_time from notify_task where notify_status in (0, 2) or (notify_status = 4 and update_time < date_sub(now(), interval 5 minute)) order by id asc limit #{limit}

select id, activity_id, team_id, notify_category, notify_type, notify_mq, notify_url, notify_count, notify_status, parameter_json, uuid, create_time, update_time from notify_task where team_id = #{teamId} and ( notify_status in (0, 2) or (notify_status = 4 and update_time < date_sub(now(), interval 5 minute)) ) order by id asc limit 50

select id, activity_id, team_id, notify_category, notify_type, notify_mq, notify_url, notify_count, notify_status, parameter_json, uuid, create_time, update_time from notify_task order by id desc limit #{limit}

select id, activity_id, team_id, notify_category, notify_type, notify_mq, notify_url, notify_count, notify_status, parameter_json, uuid, create_time, update_time from notify_task where uuid = #{uuid} limit 1
mapper.update: update notify_task set notify_count = notify_count + 1, notify_status = 1, update_time = now() where team_id = #{teamId} and uuid = #{uuid} and notify_status = 4
update notify_task set notify_count = notify_count + 1, notify_status = 2, update_time = now() where team_id = #{teamId} and uuid = #{uuid} and notify_status = 4
update notify_task set notify_count = notify_count + 1, notify_status = 3, update_time = now() where team_id = #{teamId} and uuid = #{uuid} and notify_status = 4
